messages:
maya_success_ops: Heads up — Pelican (acct PEL-920) shows weekly active seats down from 75 to 9 over the last 3 weeks, health score 42, renewal in 28 days. Billing footprint ~18k ARR. Two open tickets: TKT-5593 (integration error) and TKT-5601 (KV cache misconfig).
sam_csm: Oof. Did we get any NPS/feedback notes?
lee_onboarding: They filled baseline onboarding but skipped advanced steps (hooks & caching). Logged 'unclear config' in kickoff notes. Last host call 9 days ago.
julian_csm: I'd push a "targeted save" — 30m technical enable + 30m CSM strategy within 72h, plus a one-off performance credit if they attend and complete the quick checklist. Recommend credit $600 and an SLA for a 48h engineering triage on the two tickets.
maya_success_ops: +1. Also suggest a temporary downgrade-protection clause: if they downgrade to Starter within 60d, we give a feature-limited migration pathway and one free migration consult. That reduces churn friction.
alice_support: I can own ticket clearance. For TKT-5593 need logs and the integration key state; for TKT-5601 we can flip a proxy config. I can have both with workarounds by the walkthrough time.
dev_oncall: I can join the enablement call for the integration demo and pre-stage a small sandbox. Free windows: Tue 09:00 or Wed 14:00 PT.
sam_csm: I'll email the main contact (zoe@pelican.io) with two options and include the conditional credit language. CRM: I'll flag renewal and add task. Please add checklist items here so we have a single source of truth. :memo:
lee_onboarding: Quick checklist to require for credit: - attend both sessions - complete 3-step KV cache config - run the warmup script and share a screenshot - confirm throughput baseline 
Snippet for warmup: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-l","prompts":["hello"]}'
```
julian_csm: Owners: sam = customer comms & CRM; julian = strategy session; lee = quickstart doc & checklist; alice = tickets; dev_oncall = sandboxes. Timeline: kickoff within 72h, credit applied after checklist verified, escalation to renewal lead if no attendance within 5 days.
maya_success_ops: I'll draft the credit email template (conditional offer) and attach the downgrade-protection terms. Using template "targeted-retention-v2".
sam_csm: CRM FLAG set: RENEW-PEL-920. Task: https://crm.redwood.com/tasks/PEL-920-save. Email sent with Tue/Wed options.
ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: "Pelican save plan kickoff" Tue 08:00 PT.
julian_csm: After the walkthrough, post a short recap here with: what we demoed, ticket status, checklist verification, whether they accepted the downgrade-protect offer, and next steps. We'll then decide if we need exec outreach.
sam_csm: Thanks team — let's treat this as a high-touch intercept. I'll update the thread after the call. :thumbsup:
